lines.cyr: По пат оди Осман, за пат праша,
lines.lat: Po pat odi Osman, za pat praša,
lines.en: Osman travels along the road, asking the way,

lines.cyr: на пат една, Осман, стара баба:
lines.lat: na pat edna, Osman, stara baba:
lines.en: And on the road, he meets an old woman:

lines.cyr: - Ој ти бабо мори, стара бабо,
lines.lat: - Oj ti babo mori, stara babo,
lines.en: "Oh, good woman, dear old woman,
Where does fair Rada live?"

lines.cyr: - Бела Рада, аго, не е дома,
lines.lat: - Bela Rada, ago, ne e doma,
lines.en: "Fair Rada, agha, is not at home;

lines.cyr: ја скрени си патот горно поле,
lines.lat: ja skreni si patot gorno pole,
lines.en: Turn your path toward the upper field,
Rada is reaping the short barley there
With her little brother, brother Kosta."
Upon hearing this, Osman turned his path;
He headed straight for the upper field,
Looking out into the distance to spot
Where fair Rada was reaping.

lines.cyr: А што беше, џанум, мали Коста,
lines.lat: A što beše, džanum, mali Kosta,
lines.en: And little Kosta,
He cast a glance toward the road,
Spied the accursed Turk,
And spoke to his sister Rada:

lines.cyr: - Ој ти дадо мори, бела Радо,
lines.lat: - Oj ti dado mori, bela Rado,
lines.en: "Oh, sister mine, fair Rada,

lines.cyr: дали гледаш, сестро, што јас гледам,
lines.lat: dali gledaš, sestro, što jas gledam,
lines.en: Do you see, sister, what I see?
For the accursed Turk is coming this way,
He will wreak great havoc, sister!"
Fair Rada spoke up:

lines.cyr: - Ој ти братче море, мило братче,
lines.lat: - Oj ti bratče more, milo bratče,
lines.en: "Oh, little brother, dear brother,

lines.cyr: ја подај ми, братче, тенка пушка,
lines.lat: ja podaj mi, bratče, tenka puška,
lines.en: Hand me the slender rifle;

lines.cyr: ти нишани, братче, јас ќе пукам,
lines.lat: ti nišani, bratče, jas ḱe pukam,
lines.en: You take aim, brother, and I shall fire,
To kill the accursed Turk."

lines.cyr: А што беше, џанум, мали Коста,
lines.lat: A što beše, džanum, mali Kosta,
lines.en: But little Kosta,
He grew frightened and began to weep,

lines.cyr: па се сокри Коста под коловче.
lines.lat: pa se sokri Kosta pod kolovče.
lines.en: Then hid himself beneath a sheaf of grain.
Kosta cried out in alarm:

lines.cyr: - Не дај мене мори, дада Радо!
lines.lat: - Ne daj mene mori, dada Rado!
lines.en: "Don't let him get me, sister Rada!"
When Rada saw there was no help,
she unwound her red headscarf,
she tightened her sash,
she rolled up her sleeves,
then Rada lifted the Berdan1 rifle;
she neither took aim nor even looked -
the rifle fired, and the Turk fell.
